title: Pad: clamp and mask
hints: Two separate questions: which element would this index read if it were inside, and is it inside at all?
pad_valid is a range check on i: the real elements sit at positions l through l + n - 1.
pad_src starts from i - l, then clamps: below 0 becomes 0, above n - 1 becomes n - 1. The clamp only matters where pad_valid is 0.

answer.explain: The mask decides the value (zero outside), and the clamp keeps the read legal: a compiled pad reads `x[pad_src(...)]` on every element, even the ones the mask throws away, so an unclamped index would read outside the buffer, which is undefined behavior in C.
